propositions: The generator recognises only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, os.getenv, and entries in KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, silently skipping other os.environ attribute accesses like pop and setdefault.

A refactor from os.environ.get(key) to os.environ.pop(key, None) produces no error or warning but invisibly removes the key from docs/env-vars.md, violating the stated invariant that new reads cannot ship undocumented.
The CI drift gate fails only in the full test suite, not in make lint, so contributors receive no local feedback before the silent omission reaches CI.
The codebase contains two os.environ.pop sites and one os.environ.copy site that are either unrecognised or silently bulk-skipped, creating latent risk for future refactors.

The fix must classify every os.environ attribute access as either key-bearing (register literal arguments from get/pop/setdefault/__getitem__) or bulk-safe (copy/items/keys/etc.), and raise UnrecognisedEnvironAccess for any unhandled form.
